scenes.description: From the south-bank walk the two Portland-stone towers of Tower Bridge stand over a closed bascule roadway, joined by the high-level walkways, with the blue chains falling toward each bank. The Thames is grey-green under a solid cloud deck. It is a dry overcast morning, about 21.3°C, and the sun is not in the sky.
